description: A 210+ km network of snowmobile trails maintained by the Fort St James Snowmobile Club in partnership with the Recreation Sites and Trails Branch.
directions: If you are coming to Fort St. James on highway 27, as you are approach the Stuart River Bridge you turn left on to Sowchea road and proceed 11.2 km along sowchea and turn left on to Dickenson Loop road, proceed .5km straight ahead, you will see a trail map on your left and the parking area is straight ahead. There are 3 other locations for easy access to the trail system on the Dog Creek FSR, Pitka FSR and off the end of Baker Drive

stats.Activity Details: Horseback Riding, Wildlife Viewing, Hiking, Snowmobiling

title: Fort St James Snowmobile Trails
